name: axiom-experiment-formalisation
description: The discipline of formalising an experiment as a machine-checkable record layer — using EXPO (the ontology of scientific experiments), SUMO as upper ontology, PROV-O for lineage, and domain extensions where they run out. Governed by two laws: verified vocabulary only (a term is cited as EXPO/SUMO only if checked in a primary source; everything else is declared as your extension) and the projection law (the ontology describes your typed contracts, it never becomes the runtime source of truth — contracts win on disagreement, enforced by a CI sync-check). Tier 1 (competency questions, verified mapping, JSON-LD context) is the default; Tier 2 (OWL module, SHACL, reasoner CI) requires positive justification. Router + 15 sheets, 4 commands, 2 agents.
